name: Friendly Content Unlocker (Lite)
author: besthelptool

sections.description:
The Easiest Way to Monetize Your WordPress Content

Stop installing heavy, bloated membership plugins just to sell a single article, video, or download. Friendly Content Unlocker is the most elegant micro-paywall plugin for WordPress. It lets you lock premium content and get paid directly via PayPal without forcing your users to create accounts or subscribe to monthly plans!

Perfect for bloggers, creators, and publishers who want an instant, frictionless way to earn money from their best work.

🌟 Why Use Friendly Content Unlocker?

Instead of complex subscriptions, our plugin embraces the highly successful “pay-as-you-go” model. Your visitors simply click, pay securely through a PayPal popup, and the content unlocks immediately on the same page. No redirects, no abandoned checkouts, no friction.

  • Lightning Fast Setup: Wrap any text, image, or link in a simple shortcode and set your price. Done in 30 seconds.
  • Frictionless Checkout: Powered by the official PayPal Smart Buttons. Users never leave your site.
  • Zero Subscriptions: Stop scaring away buyers with monthly commitments. Let them buy exactly what they want.
  • Beautiful UX: A sleek, blurred overlay builds curiosity and naturally encourages conversions.
  • 100% Secure: Payments are processed entirely by PayPal. You never touch credit card data.

🚀 Ready for the Ultimate Pro Experience?

Want to completely white-label your paywall and remove limits? Upgrade to Friendly Content Unlocker Pro to get the absolute best features for maximizing your revenue!

🔥 Get the Pro License Here – One-Time Payment!

Pro Features Include:
* Full Design Customizer: Change the background color, text color, and icons to perfectly match your brand.
* Unlimited Pricing: Charge exactly what your premium content is worth—whether it’s a $5 tutorial or a $250 course asset.
* Unlimited Sites: Install the Pro version on as many websites as you own with a single license.
* No API Keys Needed: Simple, seamless setup out of the box.
* Zero Ongoing Fees: One single payment. Yours forever.

👉 Unlock Your Revenue with Pro Today

💡 How It Works (Lite Version)

  1. Go to Settings and enter your PayPal Client ID.
  2. Wrap your premium content in the [fculite_unlock price="1.00"] shortcode.
  3. Your content is instantly locked with a beautiful blur effect and a PayPal button.
  4. When a user pays, the content is revealed instantly!

External Services

This plugin relies on the official PayPal API and SDK to process payments securely.

  • What the service is: The plugin loads the PayPal JavaScript SDK directly from PayPal’s servers to render the payment buttons and handle the secure checkout popup.
  • What data is sent: When a user initiates a transaction, payment details and transaction data are sent directly from the user’s browser to PayPal to complete the transaction. The plugin does not store credit card information locally.
  • Policies: This service is provided by PayPal Inc. You can read their Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/friendly-content-unlocker-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings -> Content Unlocker and input your PayPal Client ID.
  4. Wrap your premium content in the [fculite_unlock price="1.00"] shortcode.
sections.faq:
Do I need a PayPal Business account?

A standard PayPal account can work, but a Business account is highly recommended for accessing your Client ID easily in the developer dashboard.

Is it secure?

Absolutely. The plugin uses the official PayPal JavaScript SDK. The payment is processed entirely by PayPal on their secure servers, meaning your site is never exposed to sensitive financial data.

Can I customize the look of the paywall?

Yes! The Pro Version includes a built-in Design Customizer that lets you white-label the paywall to match your site’s aesthetic perfectly.
